From the owner
Want to save money on your Chicago remodel? The biggest savings come from decisions, not discounts. Our new guide breaks down what actually lowers a remodel budget: keep your existing layout (moving plumbing is what turns a refresh into a gut job), bundle related projects into one timeline so you pay for setup once, and stay flexible on finishes where near-identical options carry very different prices. Just as important, we cover the things you should never cut, like waterproofing and permits, where false savings become the most expensive problems in the house.
Jul 7, 2026
